papers.title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
papers.desc: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems.

papers.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
papers.desc: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift.

papers.desc: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies.

papers.desc: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets.

papers.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
papers.desc: We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation.

papers.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.desc: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language.

papers.title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
papers.desc: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources.

papers.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill

papers.title: InstantHMR : Real-Time Human Mesh Recovery on Your Phone

papers.desc: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction.

papers.desc: Traditional similarity-based schema matching methods fail to resolve semantic ambiguities and conflicts in complex, domain-specific mappings due to a lack of commonsense and domain-specific knowledge.

papers.title: Energy-Tweedie: Score meets Score, Energy meets Energy
